info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Quote Update API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Quote Update API enables users to modify existing quotes in the wholesale trading environment. This endpoint allows authorized users to adjust pricing, terms, and other relevant details associated with a specific quote. Typical consumers of this API include traders and financial analysts who need to keep quotes current. By efficiently updating quote information, businesses can ensure accurate and timely responses to market changes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a specific quote in the wholesale trading quote management system. Use this operation to modify existing quote information as needed.

requestBody.description: Updates the quote management details for the specified resource. This request body should contain the necessary information to modify the existing quote, including any specific fields that need to be changed, such as pricing, quantities, or associated items.
